# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 stable** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 delivers the stable Skia m150 renderer with new image-filter and culling APIs. It also improves raster blur behavior and reduces repeated wrapper allocations when accessing an SKSurface canvas.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m150** — Brings the Chrome m150 renderer and its subsequent upstream fixes to the stable 4.150 line. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## API Surface

- **New filtering and visualization helpers** — Adds crop and empty image filters, overdraw visualization, and SKPaint.GetFastBounds for quick-reject culling. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228), [#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small-radius raster blur corrected** — Restores expected rendering behavior for raster blurs with small sigma values. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKSurface canvas wrapper cached** — Repeated SKSurface.Canvas access reuses its managed wrapper instead of allocating a new wrapper each time. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Updates the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native dependency to 14.2.1.
